final_harness_recheck.test_only_delta: Move the native async client to an independent loop; keep every request, response assertion and parameter.
final_harness_recheck.causal_reuse: The wheel/runtime, native corpora, observer and all other test functions are unchanged from the complete suites. Only the scheduling in the new wire test changed; all 12 affected wire cells and the entire 950-test focal selection were rerun on all three Python versions. Python 3.14 coverage appends those final executions to the complete suite.

scope: Only Mongoeco files changed; reference data, logs, caches and validation environments created in its ignored .tmp/find-modify directory.
publication: Not requested or performed; source package version remains 4.10.0 and this candidate is distinct from its published wheel.

legacy_async_harness.initial_result: Interrupted after 913 passing tests; isolated probe retained the blocking socket-poll stack.
legacy_async_harness.cause: The experimental PyMongo 4.9 async cursor polls synchronously, delaying a proxy hosted on the same loop.
legacy_async_harness.resolution: Give native client and proxy independent loops; retain the corpus, assertions and budgets.
legacy_async_harness.final_result: 950 passed and 4 subtests on PyMongo 4.9.2; the same focal corpus passed on 4.19.0 across all three supported Python interpreters.
